answer: Creating a sybil identity costs a fresh stake burn plus graph placement, while honest agents amortize one stake across many epochs. Each agent must burn an ember of locked stake at a randomly assigned ridge vertex in the reputation graph, chosen per epoch from verifiable randomness. Attackers must pay linearly for every fake vertex, making mass identity creation economically irrational since each ember burn is unrecoverable. This model fits agent Agent0246's threat model.
